All tests in this repository are currently passing. I've verified both the test file (`tests/test_lru.py`) and the implementation (`src/lru.py`), and everything is working correctly:

- `test_put_get` - Basic put/get operations work
- `test_missing_returns_none` - Returns None for missing keys  
- `test_evicts_oldest_without_gets` - Evicts the oldest entry when capacity is reached
- `test_get_refreshes_recency` - Getting an item refreshes its recency (moves it to end of order list)
- `test_update_existing_key` - Updating a key refreshes its recency

No fixes were needed as all tests are passing.
